📖 Core Definitions

Essential Terminology & Concepts

A Loop Core Definition

A Loop a situation where we need to execute a block of code several times.

A Function Core Definition

A Function a set of instructions that is required to execute a command to achieve a task in R.

Environment Of R Key Concept

Establishes essential concepts, mathematical or computational foundations, and techniques of environment of r.

Decision Making, Loops, Functions Key Concept

In the case of loops, the statements are executed sequentially.

Data Structures In R Key Concept

R’s basic data structures include Vector, Strings, Lists, Frames, Matrices and Arrays.

📌 Key Takeaways

Section-by-Section Study Breakdown

13.2 Environment of R

  • Establishes essential concepts, mathematical or computational foundations, and techniques of environment of r.
  • Applies standard methodologies relevant to modern data science workflows and analysis in basics of programming.

13.3 Data types, Variables, Operators, Factors

  • Every variable in R has an associated data type, which is known as the reserved memory.
  • This reserved memory is needed for storing the values.
  • Whenever a number is stored in R, it gets converted into a decimal type with at least 2 decimal points or the “double” value.
  • So, if you enter a normal integer value also, for example 10, then the R interpreter will convert it into double i.e.

13.4 Decision Making, Loops, Functions

  • In the case of loops, the statements are executed sequentially.
  • Loop Type and Description: ● Repeat loop: Executes sequence of statements multiple times.
  • ● While loop: Repeat a given statement while the given condition is true, executes before executing the loop body.
  • Syntax: Example: If condition is false Conditional code Condition If condition is true Basic of R Programming 15 ● For loop: Like while statement, executes the test condition at the end of the loop body.

13.5 Data Structures in R

  • R’s basic data structures include Vector, Strings, Lists, Frames, Matrices and Arrays.
  • Strings and Vectors Vectors: A vector is a one-dimensional array of data elements that have the same data type.
  • The most basic data structures are the Vectors, which supports logical, integer, double, complex, character data types.
  • Strings: Any value written within a pair of single quotes or double quotes in R is treated as a string.

13.5.1 Strings and Vectors

  • Vectors: A vector is a one-dimensional array of data elements that have the same data type.
  • The most basic data structures are the Vectors, which supports logical, integer, double, complex, character data types.
  • Strings: Any value written within a pair of single quotes or double quotes in R is treated as a string.
  • Internally R stores every string within double quotes, even when you create them with a single quote.

13.5.2 Lists

  • Lists are the objects in R that contain different types of objects within itself like number, string, vectors or even another list, matrix or any function as its element It is created by calling list() function.
  • Matrices, Arrays and Frames Matrices are R objects which are arranged in 2-D layout.
  • Accessing the elements of the matrix: Elements of a matrix can be accessed by specifying the row and column number.
  • Matrix Manipulations: Mathematical operations can be performed on the matrix like addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.

13.5.3 Matrices, Arrays and Frames

  • Matrices are R objects which are arranged in 2-D layout.
  • Accessing the elements of the matrix: Elements of a matrix can be accessed by specifying the row and column number.
  • Matrix Manipulations: Mathematical operations can be performed on the matrix like addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
  • You may please note that matrix division is not defined mathematically, but in R each element of a matrix is divided by the corresponding element of another matrix.

13.2 ENVIRONMENT OF R

  • Establishes essential concepts, mathematical or computational foundations, and techniques of environment of r.
  • Applies standard methodologies relevant to modern data science workflows and analysis in basics of programming.
